name: Sight LGD #4
description:
The color of our eyes is dictated by melanin
The same principles that control the color of our skin
Fascinating how we all see the same through the magic iris
But the same principles that create the magic of eye color
Sadly divide us,
Maybe someday we’ll see details within?
The color of the beauty of our eyes,
Matches the beauty,
Of our skin.
